offering_description.value: Alternative asset management firm that sells investment funds and customized portfolios across hedge funds, private equity, private credit and real assets. It serves institutional investors and manages client capital for management and performance fees.

primary_products.value: hedge fund strategies; private equity funds; private credit funds; real asset funds; customized separate accounts

primary_services.value: discretionary investment management; investment advisory and portfolio consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: pension funds, endowments, foundations, insurers, family offices, corporate investors; B2G: public pension plans and government investment funds

end_markets.value: institutional asset management; pensions and endowments; private markets investing

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: management fees on client assets and performance fees on investment gains

value_chain_position.value: service provider: manages investment portfolios for institutional clients for a fee; financial intermediary: pools client capital into funds and investment vehicles and invests it in private markets

geography_served.value: global: investors in North America, Europe, Asia and the Middle East, with offices in several countries

specialization.value: related lines: hedge funds, private equity, private credit and real assets strategies sharing institutional clients and channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct relationships with institutional investors; agents / brokers: placement agents and investment consultants who introduce investors

regulatory_exposure.value: high: registered investment adviser under the SEC and Investment Advisers Act, plus foreign regulators such as the UK FCA
